rics.meaning: Central Government Debt, Total — outstanding central-government debt. About CNY 40 trillion (2024). Excludes local-government debt (~CNY 90 trillion in special + general bonds plus implicit LGFV debt).
rics.how_to_use: Central-government debt-to-GDP ~30% (low by international standards). Total public debt including local + LGFVs ~85-90% of GDP (closer to advanced-economy norms). True 'augmented' debt including SOE liabilities is a contested research topic.
